_help: Grid penalties typed by hand. They win over the FIA documents and race control for the same driver and session. Fields: season, round, driverId (or carNumber), kind (places, back_of_grid, pit_lane, or none to cancel parsed entries), places (for kind places), appliesTo (race or sprint), category (power_unit or other, optional), note. Example: {"season": 2026, "round": 17, "driverId": "russell", "kind": "places", "places": 40, "appliesTo": "race", "category": "power_unit", "note": "PU elements"}
